title: Example Notes
description: Search and create notes on example.com as the logged-in user, through the site's own JSON API. Reads need no token; writes attach the CSRF token the session endpoint hands out.

searchNotes.returns: notes[].{id: id, title: title, updated_at: updated_at}

tools.name: notes_search
tools.description: Search the logged-in user's notes on example.com by keyword. Returns the matching notes' ids, titles, and last-updated timestamps, newest first.

query.description: Keywords to search note titles and bodies for

tools.name: notes_create
tools.description: Create a new note on example.com as the logged-in user. Returns the new note's id and URL.
